correctness.rationale: For x,y>0, d(log y-kappa log x)/dt=r_2-kappa r_1, canceled exactly by the logarithmic critical harvest; hence y_m=h x_m^kappa. Set u=e^(-r_1 s)x, v=e^(-r_2 s)y: v=h u^kappa and u_s=-a e^(r_1 s)u^2-bh e^(r_2 s)u^(kappa+1). Since u_s<0 every cycle, P(x)<x for x>0; x_m decreases to zero (a hypothetical positive limit would be a forbidden fixed point), so y_m→0. Integrating dlog(x_m/u(s))≤a I_1 x_m+bh I_2 x_m^kappa proves uniform u(s)/x_m→1; then x_m-x_(m+1)=aI_1 x_m^2(1+o(1))+bhI_2 x_m^(1+kappa)(1+o(1)). With alpha=min(1,kappa), C as in theorem, mean-value x_(m+1)^(-alpha)-x_m^(-alpha)=alpha C+o(1) and Cesaro summation give m x_m^alpha→1/(alpha C), yielding all constants and exponents. For kappa=1, exact integration gives the claimed all-m reciprocal identity. Uniform flow demodulation proves within-cycle envelopes and full physical-time extinction. Boundaries: all a,b,r_i,tau,kappa>0, strictly positive initial pair; no assertion for noncritical pulses, unequal-row perturbations, or zero initial values. Independent ODE integrations agree with kappa=0.5,1,2 constants but are finite corroboration only.

final_claim: In a two-species competitive Lotka–Volterra flow with row-2 competition exactly kappa times row-1 and harvest factors exp(-r_i tau), every positive post-pulse trajectory has invariant y_m=h x_m^kappa. With I_i=(exp(r_i tau)-1)/r_i: if 0<kappa<1 then m^(1/kappa) x_m→(kappa b h I_2)^(-1/kappa), m y_m→(kappa b I_2)^(-1); if kappa=1 then x_m^(-1)=x_0^(-1)+m(a I_1+b h I_2) and y_m=h x_m; if kappa>1 then m x_m→(a I_1)^(-1), m^kappa y_m→h(a I_1)^(-kappa). Uniform within-cycle envelopes are e^(r_i s) times post-pulse states, with one-sided pre-pulse endpoint.
limitations: Only strictly positive post-pulse initial states and exact proportional rows with exactly canceled growth are proved; no stability of these power laws under parameter detuning.
